captions.caption: Fast-moving muddy floodwaters rush through a residential street in Switzerland.
The floodwaters engulf several parked cars in a parking lot.
Muddy water continues to surge around vehicles in the flooded Swiss town.
A high-angle view shows the powerful flow of brown water through the streets.
A close-up shot captures the intensity of the floodwaters between buildings.
A torrent of mud and debris flows rapidly down a narrow street.
The flood current remains strong as it passes white residential houses.
Murky water continues to flood the area, reaching high up on the buildings.
An aerial perspective shows multiple cars stranded in deep, moving floodwaters.
The floodwaters create a wide river where streets used to be in Switzerland.
Water flows turbulently around various cars trapped in the flood.
A white car is seen being surrounded by the surging muddy flow.
The camera zooms in on cars stuck in the powerful current of the flood.
Floodwaters continue to tear through the Swiss village, showing significant force.
A street view shows the brown water flowing past shops and houses.
The flood remains intense, with large volumes of water moving through the town.
Murky floodwaters continue to inundate the residential area in Switzerland.
Extremely heavy rain and hail fall, significantly reducing visibility in Zaporozhye.
Thick streaks of rain and hail are blown by the wind across the screen.
The downpour continues with great intensity, obscuring the background trees.
A white van is barely visible through the heavy curtain of rain and hail.
A small silver car drives slowly through deep floodwaters on a city road.
The car pushes through the high water, creating large ripples and splashes.
View of the silver car navigating the flooded street during the heavy storm.
Rain continues to fall as the car moves through the inundated intersection.
A street vendor stands under a large umbrella amidst the pouring rain in Zaporozhye.
Heavy rain falls on a park area with cars parked along the road.
The ground is pelted by the intense rainfall, creating puddles.
View from under a shelter showing the persistent and heavy downpour.
The rain storm continues to lash the city streets and urban greenery.
A black screen appears with the text 1 JULY in the center.
The text 1 JULY continues to be displayed on the black background.
The screen remains black with the date 1 JULY shown.
The 1 JULY text remains on the screen as a transition between clips.
The black screen with 1 JULY persists before the next scene starts.
Heavy hail falls and bounces off a wet street in Borgosesia, Italy.
A silver SUV drives slowly through the accumulating hail on the road.
Large hailstones fall rapidly, quickly covering the asphalt in a white layer.
The sound of hail hitting the ground is intense as the storm continues.
Hail continues to pelt the street, making it look like it is covered in snow.
Close-up of hailstones bouncing on the wet pavement in Borgosesia.
The hail storm remains very active with high precipitation density.
The street is completely covered in a thick layer of white hailstones.
View from a window showing hail falling into a courtyard with parked cars.
Hailstones are seen covering the ground and the tops of parked vehicles.
A dark car is parked in the courtyard as hail continues to pelt down.
The courtyard is filled with a thick mist and rapidly falling hail.
Hail continues to fall steadily, covering the stone-paved area in Italy.
The hail accumulation increases as the severe storm persists in Borgosesia.
Large, intense orange flames from a forest fire rise into the air.
Thick black and grey smoke billows from the wildfire in Canada.
The fire rages through the trees, creating a massive wall of flames.
Intense heat and bright orange fire are visible as the forest burns.
The wildfire continues to consume vegetation, producing huge smoke clouds.
A wide shot shows the scale of the fire and smoke across the horizon.
View from a moving vehicle showing flames burning close to the roadside.
Buildings are seen engulfed in orange flames as the fire spreads rapidly.
Thick smoke obscures the surrounding area near the burning structures.
A structure is completely consumed by fierce orange and yellow flames.
The Canadian wildfire continues to burn out of control with heavy smoke.
